reviews.title: Good for Reporting ONLY — Does NOT Play Well With Other Apps
reviews.text: MySugr writes a nice report you can email your endocrinologist to see what’s necessary to set your insulin. It refuses to take data from other (“competitor”?) Apps or from Apple Health if Apple Health got it from a “competitor”App. Its explanation conflates “dietary food weight” with “body weight”. Apple Health stores these metrics in entirely separate, strictly partitioned data silos. Blocking basic BMI data under false excuse of food measurement error is nonsense and  causes consumers to have to enter the same data multiple times in the easiest way possible. Apple Health does an EXCELLENT job of capturing everything in all the different ways App builders do it and make it readily available and medically appropriate. MySugr should fix its read permissions and quit playing games.

reviews.title: Great app for tracking and managing your health
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the MySugr app to document my readings and keep track of my progress, and it has been very helpful. I really like how easy it is to use, and the app has plenty of options and features that make keeping up with my information more convenient—and even a little fun.

Another thing I really appreciate is how well it connects with the equipment I currently use to take my readings. The readings can sync directly with the app, making the whole process feel effortless and saving me from having to enter everything manually.

Overall, MySugr has made it much easier for me to stay organized, monitor my progress, and keep a better record of my health information. I’m very happy with the app and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for an easy and convenient way to keep track of their readings.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text:
I’ve been using mySugr for a while now, and it has truly transformed how I manage my diabetes. The app not only helps me track my blood sugar levels effectively, but it also provides invaluable insights into my health journey.

One of the standout features is the ability to log medications and see how they impact my sugar levels. It’s incredibly helpful to have a space for notes and tags, allowing me to track when I take my meds and observe their effects over time. This functionality has made it easy to identify patterns, especially when certain foods cause my sugars to spike.

The app’s intuitive design makes it simple to navigate through my data, and I love how it encourages me to make adjustments to my routine. Whether it’s modifying my diet or changing my medication times, I can see the direct impact on my blood sugar levels. 

Overall, mySugr has become an essential tool in my diabetes management toolkit, making it easier to stay on top of my health and make informed decisions. Highly recommend it to anyone looking to take control of their diabetes!

reviews.title: Handy tool
reviews.text:
This is a very handy app to have for those that have trouble keeping a record of their blood sugar if taken multiple times a day. It stores all of your values and even allows you to put in customized fields notating whether you’re fasting or not, if it’s before or after a meal and more specifically your symptoms at that time. 

It allows me to look back and see what may have caused a rapid change. Very easy to navigate and it syncs with your phone by Bluetooth. I’ve never found an app this good for keeping track of sugar! 100% recommend this one, even beginners can get the hang of it.
